item: Custody: a lone surrogate is refused by name and a bundle's unsigned fields cannot contradict its signed head (open-on-main row 46)
summary: Row 46, Lane F's part (the GET key-minting part is Lane U's U3). POST /api/custody/log answered 500 on a lone surrogate (JSON \ud800), which has no UTF-8 form so no signature can cover it; record() now refuses it by name before anything is read or written and the route answers 400. A bundle's top-level log_version, entry_count and bundle_format are not signed: the checker now refuses one that disagrees with the signed head and prints the head's. The printed signer must be the identity the head was signed with, both halves, in every mode, so a bundle cannot print a post-quantum key nothing in it was signed with, and a head stripped of its post-quantum half is refused without --pin too.
